section_summary.extract_value: This section details the experimental procedure. Participants first completed questionnaires on mental toughness, self-evaluations, videogame experience, ACT score, and goal orientation. They then underwent training and practice trials in UT2004, followed by baseline performance tests, a pre-practice self-efficacy questionnaire, 20 practice trials, and finally four test trials for post-practice performance and adaptive performance. Objective computer-controlled opponent difficulty levels (5 for baseline/practice/post-practice, 6 for adaptive performance) were used, with adaptive performance trials also featuring a larger and more varied geographical layout.
